title: Representation and Reference Selection in Training-Free Synthetic Image Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2607.12052v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Synthetic image attribution aims at identifying the generator responsible for a given AI-generated image. Training-free reference-based attribution methods are easily scalable, since newly emerging generators can be incorporated by adding source-specific references rather than retraining a task-specific classifier. Their performance depends on two coupled factors: the representation space used for comparison and the way source-specific references are constructed. However, the interaction between these two factors remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we provide a controlled analysis of this interaction using references and off-the-shelf pretrained representations. We study representations extracted from different layers of CLIP and DINOv2, along with three reference selection strategies with varying semantic constraints: arbitrary, semantically aligned, and resynthesis-based references. translated_title: 免训练合成图像归因中的表示与参考选择
translated_abstract: 合成图像归因旨在识别生成给定AI生成图像的生成器。免训练的基于参考的归因方法易于扩展，因为新出现的生成器可以通过添加特定来源的参考图像来纳入，而无需重新训练特定任务的分类器。其性能取决于两个相互耦合的因素：用于比较的表示空间以及构建特定来源参考的方式。然而，这两个因素之间的相互作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们使用参考图像和现成的预训练表示对这种相互作用进行了受控分析。我们研究了从CLIP和DINOv2不同层提取的表示，以及三种具有不同语义约束的参考选择策略：任意参考、语义对齐参考和基于再合成的参考。我们的结果表明，归因……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过受控实验系统揭示了免训练合成图像归因中表示空间选择（CLIP与DINOv2不同层的表示）和参考选择策略（任意、语义对齐、基于再合成）之间的耦合关系及其对归因性能的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a controlled analysis of the interplay between representation space choice (layer-wise representations from CLIP and DINOv2) and reference selection strategies (arbitrary, semantically aligned, and resynthesis-based) in training-free synthetic image attribution.
